cycle.label: Permit period
cycle.note: Kansas permits renew every two years on July 1; CPE runs July 1 – June 30 over the two years before: 80 hours, 2 of them ethics.

requirements.label: Total CPE
requirements.note: 80 hours each permit period (K.A.R. 74-4-7). Up to 20 extra hours carry forward (not toward ethics).

requirements.label: Personal development
requirements.note: Maximum, not a target. Personal development is limited to 30% (24 hours).

requirements.label: Professional ethics
requirements.note: 2 hours of professional ethics relating to CPA practice each period.

newLicensee.note: First period prorated: 10 hours for each full quarter after your permit was issued

licenseDateHint: June 30 before your permit renews on July 1 (odd or even years by your certificate number).
issueDateHint: If your permit was issued during this period, hours are prorated by quarter.
limitsNotTracked: Instruction and preparation: max 50%; college credit: max 50%.
Municipal public accountants: 16 hours a year, 8 in municipal A&A.
recordRetention: Keep CPE records for six years from the end of the year completed.
toVerify: New-permit proration (10 hours per full quarter; the Board shows the exact hours on the renewal form).
Ethics prorated with the total for a new permit.
